course.intro: Use this as an exam-style requirement brief. It defines what competent work must demonstrate without giving a finished solution.
plainEnglish: Understand the behavior behind ARM Assembly Programming, trace it with evidence, and transfer it to a fresh case.

requirements: Apply ARM Assembly Programming to a new problem instead of only recognizing a completed example.
Explain the important register, memory, flag, control-flow, timing, or architecture behavior in ordinary language.
Trace a normal case before relying on a simulator or supplied answer.
Trace at least one boundary or failure case.
Justify each major instruction, rule, or calculation.
Verify the final observable state or result with explicit evidence.
State assumptions clearly when browser execution cannot reproduce the target hardware.
